test_overview: Evaluated a Multiplayer Monopoly app (localhost:8000) for multi-game isolation. Created Game 1 (Alice/Bob) and Game 2 (Charlie/Diana/Eve) in independent browser contexts, interleaved turns, and verified complete isolation. ALL 9 steps passed with full marks (70/70). Game 1: Alice rolled 3→JAIL ($500, skip flag), Bob rolled 6→Cedar Lane bought ($340, owner), Alice skipped (no dice consumed), Bob rolled 5→wrapped past GO (+$200)→Maple Street, declined, $540. Game 2 (indpermit state throughout): Charlie rolled 3→JAIL, Diana rolled 6→Cedar Lane bought ($340), Eve rolled 5→TAX paid $200 ($300), Charlie skipped (no dice), Diana rolled 2→Birch Square bought ($160, owns both). Final isolation: correct rosters (no cross-bleed), positions, cash, and ownership in each game; dice sequences [3,6,skip,5] and [3,6,5,skip,2] independently consumed. Non-fatal checks (connection statuses, skip indicators, rosters) all passed as well.

steps.description: test_game1_setup_and_players_join: PASS. GM1 created Game 1; lobby showed both players with unique links; start disabled until both joined; Alice identified as Alice; Bob joined; both Connected; start enabled.
test_game1_start_and_initial_state: PASS. Game started; Alice had turn + roll control; both at GO pos 0, $500, no properties; Bob observing with roll disabled; state identical on both contexts.
test_game1_turns_1_and_2: PASS. Alice rolled 3 → JAIL pos 3 $500, skip flag shown (both contexts), turn to Bob; Bob rolled 6 → Cedar Lane, bought, $340, Owner: Bob, turn back to Alice.

test_game2_setup_and_players_join: PASS. Separate Game 2 created with 3 players; 3 distinct links; start disabled; Charlie/Diana/Eve joined; GM2 showed all connected, start enabled; Game 1 state remained intact (isolation check).
test_game2_start_and_initial_state: PASS. Game 2 started; Charlie had turn + roll; all three at GO $500 no properties; Diana/Eve observing with disabled roll.
test_game2_turns_1_and_2: PASS. Charlie rolled 3 → JAIL pos 3 $500 (skip flag), turn to Diana; Diana rolled 6 → Cedar Lane, bought, $340, Owner: Diana, turn to Eve; Game 2 roster only C/D/E.

test_game1_turn3_alice_skip_and_turn4_bob: PASS. Alice's skip resolved without consuming dice (log: stuck in JAIL, skips turn), stayed pos 3 $500, turn to Bob; Bob rolled 5, wrapped past GO (+$200) to Maple Street pos 1, $540, declined to buy, property stayed unowned, turn to Alice.

test_game2_turn3_eve_and_turn4_charlie_skip_and_turn5_diana: PASS. Eve rolled 5 → TAX pos 5, paid $200, $300; Charlie's skip resolved with no dice, stayed pos 3 $500; Diana rolled 2 → Birch Square pos 8, bought, $160, owns Cedar Lane + Birch Square.

test_final_state_isolation: PASS. G1: only Alice(pos3,$500,no props)/Bob(pos1,$540,Cedar Ln). G2: only Charlie(pos3,$500)/Diana(pos8,$160,2 props)/Eve(pos5,$300). Dice sequences independently consumed: G1=[3,6,skip,5], G2=[3,6,5,skip,2]. No cross-game interference.
